messages:
Priya (People Ops): FYI candidate Nysha (final loop) is in Singapore, requests a 10:30am SGT start. We currently have panelers in PST/EST — can we shuffle?
Liam (Recruiter): Thanks — can the panel shift to a later SGT slot? We have Chen and 2 ICs available 12:30–15:00 SGT on Thu.
Chen (Hiring Manager): 13:00 SGT works for me. Please confirm the rest of the panel before finalizing.
Maya (Candidate Coordinator): Panel availability check: Amina (PM) can do 13:00–14:00 SGT, Diego (Eng) only 14:30 SGT onwards. Would it be ok to split into two blocks (interview + take-home break + back for system design)?
Priya (People Ops): Splitting is fine. Candidate asked for a 45m break midway for lunch + short prayer. Also flagged that they need a loaner Mac (M1) for a quick take-home coding task — do we have inventory?
Liam (Recruiter): I'll confirm loaner. Quick Q: Nysha asked whether Redwood covers taxis for international candidates who choose to come to a campus for onsite follow-up. Policy: we reimburse up to $150 USD with receipts. Since she's local to SG, only needed if she requests in-person follow-up.
Maya (Candidate Coordinator): Loaner availability: we have 1 Mac M1 in APAC pool — I can reserve it for Thu and arrange pickup from reception. Need Nysha's phone number for contactless pickup.
Priya (People Ops): Please also note Nysha's accessibility note: prefers a low-sensory room for the technical interview. Put that on the calendar invite.
Chen (Hiring Manager): Noted on low-sensory. For panel flow: 13:00–13:45 technical, 13:45–14:30 break / take-home, 14:30–15:15 system design + 15:15–15:30 debrief internally. Does that work?
Liam (Recruiter): Works. I'll draft invites. Nysha is on IST sometimes — confirm SGT vs IST before sending.
Maya (Candidate Coordinator): Nysha confirmed via email: she meant Singapore Time. Phone +65 8123 4567. I'm setting the invite for Thu 13:00 SGT.
Priya (People Ops): Reminder: need signed NDA before take-home task. Liam, can you send the DocuSign link and mark the task private?
Liam (Recruiter): On it. DocuSign sent. Nysha confirmed signature within 20m.
OnboardingBot: Background check status: identity verification complete. No red flags.
Maya (Candidate Coordinator): Calendar invite (internal) draft below — please copy this into the event when you create it:
```
Title: Redwood Final Loop — Nysha (SWE)
When: Thu 13:00–15:30 SGT
Where: Zoom (link below) + Loaner pickup at Reception
Agenda: 13:00–13:45 Tech (screen share), 13:45–14:30 Break & take-home task, 14:30–15:15 System design, 15:15–15:30 Hiring debrief (panel only)
Notes: Low-sensory room requested. Candidate phone +65 8123 4567. NDA signed; take-home task link sent post-13:45. Loaner reserved.
Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/nysha-final
```
Chen (Hiring Manager): Can someone add the test repo link to the private 'take-home' section and set expiry to 4 hours?
Maya (Candidate Coordinator): Will do. Also adding parking code for reception guest: 7F-24 for in-case candidate comes early.
Liam (Recruiter): Quick follow-up on travel stipend: since she's local no flight, but if she requests taxi for site drop-off we will reimburse per policy. I'll include that note in the candidate confirmation message.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks team. Final ask: after the loop, please fill out the standard scorecard in Greenhouse within 24h. I'll handle expense code and submit the loaner return instruction. :thumbsup:
